task.question: Who won the 2026 United Bowl on June 13, 2026?
task.evidence: June 13: 2026 United Bowl in Washington, D.C. Louisville Kings defeated DC Defenders, 27–20

answer:
The Louisville Kings won the 2026 United Bowl, defeating the DC Defenders with a score of 27–20 on June 13, 2026. This victory marked the Kings' first United Bowl title. 

FINAL: Louisville Kings

[The Mosquito Bowl] The Mosquito Bowl is an upcoming American war film directed by Peter Berg and produced by Film 44 and Imagine Entertainment for Netflix. It is based on the 2022 Buzz Bissinger book The Mosquito Bowl: A Game of Life and Death in World War II, about the Mosquito Bowl game played during World War II. The film stars Nicholas Galitzine, Bill Skarsgård, Ray Nicholson, and Tom Francis in the leading roles. [2026 United Bowl] The 2026 United Bowl was the third championship of the United Football League, and it was the first to be played under the United Bowl name. The game was played on June 13, 2026, at Audi Field in Washington, D.C.. The contest determined the champion of the 2026 UFL season and was played between the Louisville Kings and the DC Defenders. The game began at 3:00 p.m. EDT and aired on ABC. The Kings won 27–20, earning their first United Bowl title. | other articles: Super Bowl LX, List of Super Bowl champions
